notes.title: 🎉 Introducing the 8 going on ∞ Update! 🎉
notes.notes:
Greetings, friendship-ruining game enthusiasts! It's been an incredible journey of 8 years, and we’d like to thank you for sticking around with a special kind of update.  

8 is the magic number in this update, and we're bringing you some new features to keep things fresh from here to infinity! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/112ac8c5a6142b7ceb3192d7e69d5caffa6cbf94.png

🏆 Eight time's the charm! 
From March 14th to March 28th, we're rewarding players for every 8th round won during online play! That's right, not matches, but rounds! Stay sharp, because after every 8th victorious round, you'll receive a random item that you don't already own. You can do this up to 8 times a day, so keep those wins coming!

🔥 Top Tier Tweets! 
If you manage to clinch 8 consecutive match wins, you'll earn yourself a spot in the limelight! Win 8 times in a row and we’ll shout you out on Twitter, for posterity. Just remember, this time it’s matches, not rounds! 

🥇 Hall of Fame
Check out our brand new Hall of Fame feature in the Play Online section. To grab a spot, you guessed it, you’ll have to bag 8 back-to-back match victories or more! It's not just about winning; it's about etching your name into Move or Die history! 

Last but not least, thank you for 8 incredible years of laughter, loudness and awesome memories. Here's to an infinity more! 


Team MoD

notes.title: Slather on some sunscreen for our latest update - Everybody Loves Summer!
notes.notes:
Love it or hate it, summer is here in all its red-hot glory. Since for many of us this just means more reasons to stay inside, we figured it's a good time to spice up our roster with some brand new summer-themed characters and consumables. So grab your shades, slather on some sunscreen, and let's jump right in!

Two new sun-kissed characters make their debut in the form of an unruly ice cooler and a very entry-level swimmer:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/2da2e7f1f7cadd50576a74b04599ce2e80cca92f.gif
Chill Bill, seen here shivering - a consequence of his own success. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/5759f1774dd9d8c701b4735c79bc825b2f91edb7.gif
Flo, an avid enthusiast of drifting around in no particular direction. 

There are also summer-themed cosmetics to be had, like the newly added scorching Sun splatter and the refreshing Cocktail trail. They will be unlockable between June 29th, 10 AM PDT - July 13th, 10 AM PDT after playing online matches.

To sweeten the deal even further on these already free characters and cosmetics, we’re discounting Move or Die a whopping 75% as part of the Steam Summer Sale. Such a shiny deal that you shouldn’t be staring straight at it. 

That’s about it for our brief summer patch, but rest assured that we’re coming back soon with even more goodies. Hope you have a swell and not too sweltering summer! 


 Team MoD

notes.title: Taking a breather this Holiday Season with the Too Cozy To Care winter update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

With so much going on all the time, caring is getting to be a bit of a chore, especially during the holidays. That’s why, for this winter update, we’re tuning out the trauma and opening up our hearts to all things cozy! 

From cuddles to hot cocoa and perfectly fitting snuggies, this update is all about kicking back and taking a breather while the world goes to heck around us. 

First of all, we have a tender trio of cozy characters you should all get to know! 
 Brady, the spa loving sloth with a heart of “not caring about your problems.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/90a75daded5926f4c3e8de63fdd5dcdd102ce1df.gif 
 Blanket, you average hot cocoa enjoyer that simply can’t be bothered

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c8003cd092e99dd5cb0730fb991a9a4799f8f43a.gif
  Cuddles, the festive kitty that loves chaos but also sleeps 16 hours a day 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/38ca764c82b0d08e5c74584cb3df81f4adf659fb.gif
There are also cozy consumables to be had, with a peaceful angel outline as a new violent death splatter and scrumptious pretzel trails to help you find your way home after wandering the forest. 

That’s about it for our snug little winter update. We hope it made things just a little bit comfier for you, wherever you may be. Next year, the madness starts anew with a whole slew of surprises waiting to be announced. But until then, please enjoy your cozy holidays! 

P.S. We finally "fixed" TacoMan <3.

All the best, 
Team MoD

notes.title: This fall, we Splice It Up with our Halloween Mini-Update!
notes.notes:
As the leaves do their thing and seasonal depression sets in, we wanted to mix things up a bit for our yearly Halloween Update. And by “things” we definitely mean body parts. 
 
Please give a warm welcome to our latest seasonal special - The Splice It Up Mini-Update! 
 
So there’s this doctor, right? And he likes to take a little bit of this and a little bit of that and then put everything back together in no discernable order, like if Humpty Dumpty was operated on by Frankenstein. Some of the good doctor’s ensuing monstrosities have somehow escaped and are now on the loose, terrorizing average Joes. The least you can do is get to know them, maybe that’ll give you some sort of upper hand: 
 

 Sharkmera is what happens when you cross a shark, a fly and uhm… a couple of other things. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/03c8eb8eaa4ac47576c7d2464338bf38c5f040fe.gif
 Mouthclops is a failed experiment in seeing if you counteract morning breath with bedroom eyes. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35c3617994ff05aff4b2b16c87c6b38e76e492fd.gif
 Constraintine had a fear of missing out that tragically turned into a reality of missing parts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/062eaf738ff4ee57064dc9cb0ca8573d260801e3.gif
 Last but not least, Swampear is what happens when you ask the wrong person to “grow a pear.” 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9ec6570c607f21a27569de8ec1a83b64c359bb5a.gif

 
We’ll go out on a limb and guess you’ll have a blast losing friends and causing mayhem in these skins. 
As with every Halloween update, we’ve also given Move or Die a monstrous makeover, complete with pools of blood, sinister sounds and pictures that you’ll see in Rorschach form for years to come! 

There are creepy cosmetics to be had, with items such as DNA trails and Chalk Outline death splatters up for grabs as soon as the update goes live. And as an extra treat, we're bringing all the Dead by Daylight Collab items back in rotation, just in case you missed them the first time around. You can do this if you play an online match between October 25th, 10 AM PDT - November 8th, 10 AM PDT.

 
Thanks for stopping by and stay tuned for more awesome news to come. 

- Team Move or Die 🐔

notes.title: Move or Die and Dead by Daylight present: the Thrill of the Hunt Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there buds or shall we say survivors? 😱


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/83f5add0d954339ab85daca7ea744c3cc98cb7ab.gif


This summer, Dead by Daylight and Move or Die try to play nice together in the aptly dubbed Thrill of the Hunt Update! Surprised? Careful, that’s one of the first steps in getting yourself murdered. 

Here’s what you’ll find or, more probably, what may find you in this killer collaboration! 


Killers on the loose

This wouldn’t be much of a guest appearance without us giving the ol’ Move or Die makeover to some of Dead by Daylight’s creepiest killers… plus Genny! You can now bump in the dark, especially when playing with the Lights Off mutator, against certified slayers like Trapper, Huntress or Blight, but also sigh in relief at the sight of Genny, a lighter addition to our roster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35d58534d427ad4b9211e5343add50b342459f0f.gif


Blood-curdling cosmetics 

Killers often leave their mark at the scene of the crime, so we came up with some appropriate items for you to hang on to while cowering in fear. There’s a Scratches Trail to let others know that danger is near, a new Dead by Daylight-inspired Emote Wheel for when you’re too terrified to talk and new Death Splatters for when you inevitably meet your demise. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/be1266e054475f18b21a34d7a790b1ab07974fc8.gif

All of the new characters and cosmetics will be unlocked at random by playing online matches. 


Game Mode Makeover
 
To keep up with this update’s killer theme, certain game modes have also gotten the horror treatment - Radiation, Loot Grab and Spike Ball are now adorned with Dead by Daylight cosmetics which will be available for a month from now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/85e8ec0c9832e8ece965bed80b510e3a641f5fbd.gif


Last but not least, we’re unlocking 6 New Community Debt Characters for you to enjoy. As per usual, all you have to do to unlock them is contribute to the ever-increasing Community Debt Bar.

For more info on everything we've added, tweaked, fixed, and made spooky:
👉 Head over to our patchnote list!

Before we say goodbye, we’d like to thank the awesome people at Dead by Daylight for making this crossover update possible. For a bunch of stone-cold killers, they seem really nice. 


Now go out there and make a killing! 
See ya in the bloody lobby \o
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! - 6 Year Anniversary Update for Move or Die!
notes.notes:
Hey there gang!

Remember that last update where we made a ton of promises? Those sounded good, right? Well, we came to deliver with the MOVE OR DIE 6th ANNIVERSARY UPDATE! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/20c369f83441c63200f58172ba79f91616c8811b.png

That's right, some of you die-hard fans have been playing our party game for 6 whole years! Time sure flies when you're having fun! Doesn't it just fill you with existential dread? Now, let's all calm down a little bit and finally get back to addressing those promises that we made. 

First of all, we finally have a new game mode in the pipeline!!! It's not launching today, as we're still doing some last minute balancing and testing, but you shall be able to play it very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/7b3e5aed9e6e863a862d17f94047d9738c2cf1a7.gif

This first new game mode is called Pandora's Blast! We don't wanna spoil too much about it, but you can be sure that avoiding those demonic eyes is gonna be one of your top priorities.

Complementing the new mode, we have the titular Pandora’s Box as a character! This box loves making people miserable, and hopefully you can use it to make your friends hate you even more than they already do. I mean, that's the point of the game right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9520bd47162cef0d7aaf345b22f324df08c71ef3.gif

You can get Pandora's Box by simply playing an online match during the next couple of weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/eada806a5fdc64112ecd5914a220a103de4a52be.gif

But the box ain’t all, as we have a whole slew of new characters coming to the Community Debt Unlock Bar! Some quick spoilers below, for your personal enjoyment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9a76334221550f10c262c804a563e73d15e7299f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c3c85d93ab75e3016c94ac6f6e2152bdc8cca34f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6c498eaf2e2b89afee7b7be34bf735ab176c57fd.gif

Wow, we are really getting stuffed with characters, huh? And speaking of the Community Debt Bar, remember all of last year's characters? Well, since you've most likely missed some of them, we're giving you a second chance. All of the 2021 released cosmetics will now be available in the Not-A-Store and Bid Wars rotation.

Of course, this means a new Daily Contribution season is starting today, so your previous progress has been reset.

As promised, there's a whole lot of bug fixes and quality of life improvements that we plan on bringing to the game in 2022. This update will contain the first set of changes that we think will make the game more stable and enjoyable. To check out the most recent changes, please head on out to the Patch Notes page on our website.

Thank you for sitting through all that, we appreciate your time and hope it was worth it. 

To reward all your hard work, here's a sneak peek at what’s coming next, later this year: 

 some exciting crossover content you will NOT expect 
 more bug fixes and quality of life improvements
 more game modes
 more mutators
 many more cute characters and cosmetics
 and more Move or Die fun!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/4b5ae01c9a195e8f9712dbdceb9b6e9103d0ded3.png

Make sure to follow us on Twitter and join the community on our Discord Server!

We hope you enjoy, and thank you for playing.
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: The Act Like It’s Christmas Mini-Update! The stage is set!
notes.notes:
This winter, be it rain or snow or seemingly never-ending global pandemic, the show must go on! 

So suit up and get ready to break some legs because this holiday season we’re setting the stage for The Act Like It’s Christmas Mini-Update! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/ee322d65eb1c581c4dea6feea7b3bc39eb8d68fc.png

Five new characters are making their theatrical debut and all of them are tough acts to follow. We have the front and rear ends of a reindeer, a kid with a needlessly complex Shakespearean costume and, because it’s Christmas after all, a Bible-accurate angel to watch over you while you sleep. It’s just a kid in a costume, but the fear is real.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/de00a2dd986de824e6d7911b852214e8710d5a96.gif 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/e496c6d404df96ebf057c77a35b1a011bb03e636.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/831ac211b89fa17f9a5bcffe4732abada32222c8.gif


A special snowflake of a character will also be added to the Move or Die roster. His name is Deepflake and what makes him unique is that he won’t be coming to the Debt Bar or Not-A-Store™, but instead he’ll be awarded for FREE to anyone playing an online multiplayer match between December 22nd and January 5th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c7187ee0201a6028ba3d93e2f85029de361fd5f1.gif


And of course, it wouldn’t be a holiday update without our classic 75% winter discount - perfect as a last-minute gift idea or a great icebreaker for the ol’ Christmas table!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c960ca21ff2e4f276d2e6d3f1cff688c4170902d.png

What's to come in 2022!

Last but not least, we leave you with the greatest gift of all - promises! 

This year, we dedicated all of our time and resources towards guaranteeing a steady flow of cosmetics and professional localization work to the game. While this was a very pretty big deal for us, we're once again confirming the fact that we hear you loud and clear. 

You want NEW GAME MODES and MUTATORS, as well as other additional ways to spice up your Move or Die experience from a gameplay standpoint.

For 2022, while the speed at which we bring updates to the game might slow down a bit, we are 100% committed to bringing at least 3 new game modes (that are already in development) as well as a handful of new mutators, to make them even more crazy. 

In 2022, we're also dedicated to fixing a lot of the longstanding issues and bugs that have been plaguing the game for the last couple of years. Yes, this includes such classics as the Shuriken Parry issue, the infamous audio glitch, as well as a slew of other stability issues for all platforms (Linux included). 

So keep your eyes peeled for the 6th Year Anniversary Roadmap, which will be announced sometime in early Spring 2022. 

Besides these, a steady flow of new characters & other cosmetics will continuously be added to the Debt Bar unlock system every month!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/0eb7a21141c2325a8591ad0a0b1edcb6b36d48a0.png

Thank you so much for your patience and continuous support. We promise to make 2022 worth it for everyone.

See ya on the other side!

-Team Move or Die

notes.title: LA FIESTA LATINA MINI-UPDATE - New Move or Die Celebration
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends!

Even though 2021 has so far been another year of mostly in-door activities, our plan to bring Move or Die to as many audiences as possible for our 5th Anniversary Journey, is still very much right on track.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/0ee141bcd04e1b17728d87d35d58a9f54e75b92f.png

While earlier this year, our main characters traveled through mainland China, to bring everyone the ‘’Lunar New Year Mini-Update'’, the time has finally come for us to make a pit stop in lovely Latin America!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6f0fbafd756762f8dce89cc7d1af95ba007e2789.png

With the ‘’La Fiesta Latina Mini-Update’’ we plan on taking another look at the Brazilian Portuguese and Argentinian Spanish localizations that are currently in the game, while also spicing things up with a couple new character skins that we know you’ll love to pick in your friendly brawls both on the couch and online.

Thus, get ready to meet Al, the traveling Alpaca; Nada, the snackable tango dancer and Jo, the tactical ball! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/1dbba05e0673fc4f4f0ee9eeb2eb3c66b2736472.jpg

Al is a pretty laid back dude. That could be either because he is originally from a country with “Chill” in its name or because, generally, alpacas dislike drama. He might also spit on you for no reason, but don’t take it personally. It’s just because he likes you a whole lot.

Nada is full of life and bursting with excitement (and beef). Though sometimes she might seem a little too hot to handle, you can rest easy knowing that her crusty exterior hides a warm heart and a whole lot of flavor.

Joseph Gabonito (also known as Jo to their friends) works hard and plays hard. In their spare time, they like to kickback, relax and just roll with whatever the day throws at them. Though beloved by millions around the world, Jo can’t help but feel that sometimes people just hang around them for kicks and giggles.

These three characters will be unlockable through the Community Debt Bar system. So get online and play a couple of rounds of the Community Debt Challenge! As this is a community wide effort, every small bit of contribution counts. Once unlocked, the characters will be available to keep for all players, forever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/609a7c18385327dd815424b8156c1a035073b317.png

As per usual with these localization mini-updates, we greatly appreciate your feedback on any potential language typos, grammar mistakes or any other bugs that you might consider to be relevant or outright annoying. 

Please drop us all of your reports over at: https://forms.gle/wgVxJkp5zM4QND2v9

Thank you oh so much for being part of our 2021 world wide adventure! See you at the next checkpoint!

-Team Move or Die

notes.title: Let our 4-Year Adventure Update Commence!
notes.notes:
Hey there, gang, 

It’s been 4 years since we all started moving or otherwise dying together. Can you believe it? Time sure flies when you’re losing all your friends. Luckily, we have just the thing to keep you entertained for a couple of years more - The 4 Year Adventure Update, complete with crippling student debt! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/984c440bf3182f0ad36d1d061c4b07a863f574c9.png

Here’s what we’re bringing to the post-grad party:

The Community Debt - a new Graduation themed event to replace the old and rusty Daily Challenge. Earn your daily income, then spend it towards the global community goal. Trust us, the benefits are very much worth it. Just like in real life. 

2 New Characters - Greysan and Hans join the ranks of Move or Die graduates, as part of a new series of unlockable rewards, bringing the total number of Move or Die playable characters to 95.

Other Exclusive Timed Unlocks - there’s already several other additions such as emote packs, splatters, confetti and trails waiting to be unlocked. 

Continuous Support - we plan on maintaining and reiterating upon this new community challenge mechanic, so expect new content to keep being added to the progress bar in the near future. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/d49e4b5b55ed5e2efcb02c20bcb15d598482da94.gif


Now, just so you can’t say that we peaked in college, we’re going to keep doing our best to provide you with compelling new content each chance we get. Just because we’re getting older, doesn’t mean we’re slowing down.  

P.S. We’re also on sale on Steam until March 1st, so go get that discount while you can!

Go chase your dreams, and that hat. 
- Team Move or Die

notes.title: The Warming Signs Update is here, hopefully not too late!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/0e418f3b6124b079d035bd71488249516e8e230a.jpg

It’s that most wonderful time again, but, this year, the tidings are kind of bleak. We just couldn't get ourselves in the holiday mood, while out there the polar bears are turning brown and bright Scandinavian kids are getting bullied by boomers. 

So, like the many cold showers we’re about to take next summer, here’s what you can expect from the Warming Signs Update:

3 Bleak New Characters:

 SHELLY, the Turtle

Seagulls, sharks and now this. After many distressing encounters, Shelly had finally had enough of deep-sea littering. “It was the plastic straw that broke the camel’s back.” said Shelly as he began swimming towards the colder, Scandinavian waters, which would eventually lead to his demise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/bc614a3096901413d1aab4674deba3ecd3a7de9d.png

 CLAYTON, the Mudman

Having started off as your run-of- the-mill enchanted snowman, Clayton didn’t live up to his name until later in life. The gift of sentience quickly became a tragic curse, for once the snow had melted away, all that was left was filth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/3299136c8db6919659586c7504326ef7563d3e1a.png

 FRAM, the Brown Polar Bear

What at first glance appeared to be a tiny spot of poo, was soon revealed to be something even fouler. Try as he might, Fram the polar bear just couldn’t get the damned thing off his otherwise pristine fur. Little did he know that this was the beginning of a new phase in his life - browning up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/d6be51ac20a1849b298dd047c3ac06f2e9d1f096.png


Other Small Changes

 Twitch Integration Fixes - Some of our favorite broadcasters reported game freezes and crashes when you guys spammed too many PogChamps in chat. This should now be fixed.
 Environmentally Themed Guilt-trips - Because without any winter, there can’t really be any winter updates anymore. No pressure! 



Thanks for sticking around for yet another year of Move or Die. See you next decade! 
- The TAG team
